compute_map_evaluation: compute mean average precision (mAP) and per-query average precision for instance retrieval results
compute_ap_precision: compute average precision for a single query given zero-based ranks of positive images
score_ap_from_ranks_1: compute average precision of one search using the Holidays and INSTRE package convention
evaluate_instance_retrieval: evaluate instance retrieval results by computing mAP, per-query AP, and precision at k
test_evaluate_functions: test the instance retrieval evaluation functions with sample ranked results and ground truth
